based_on: exp1.5 v3 (lr=1e-6 x 500: no persistent Q displacement, MC1 fail) and exp1.5 v2 (lr=1e-5: policy collapse at update 55). 3e-6 is the pre-registered midpoint probe of the untested dose interval.
purpose: Dose-response point 2: can a Stage-A dose move Q persistently WITHOUT collapsing? Endpoint-first gated design: phase 3 initially runs only ckpt 0 and 500 (3 seeds, 6 cells); the full 6-checkpoint grid is unlocked only if an expansion gate passes (exp1_6_gate_eval.py). Registered 2026-07-19; see EXPERIMENT_1_6_PLAN_ZH.md. FORMAL LAUNCH REQUIRES TEAM ACK recorded in the launch commit message.

expansion_gates.rule: expand phase 3 to the full 6-checkpoint grid (exp1_6_config_fullgrid.json, same run dir) iff G-A (late-window mean erank_L12 displacement >= 7.5% vs ckpt-0) OR G-B (3-seed mean delta at ckpt-0 minus ckpt-500 >= 0.05) passes; otherwise stop after the endpoint probe and report to the team
expansion_gates.ga_threshold_rationale: exp1.5 v3 (lr=1e-6) late-window mean was -1.2%; healthy single-point run-to-run spread reaches ~9% but the 3-checkpoint late-window mean suppresses single-point noise; 7.5% sits above v3's healthy value by >6x while staying below MC1's 10% so a near-threshold dose still earns outcome data

open_team_questions: Base vs Instruct model (cheaper default kept: base)
GRPO vs SFT adaptation (default kept: GRPO)
SVAMP transfer-headroom confound confirmed in exp1.5 v3 (delta vs before rho=-0.66); svamp_before is recorded per cell and must be a covariate in any exp1.6 correlation readout
KL beta>0 arm remains OFF here; single-variable dose change only (lr 1e-6 -> 3e-6)

optional_klreg_arm.note: Prepared but not run (carried forward from exp1.5 v3 unchanged). Enabling it is a separate team decision.
